criteria.notes: The fixed 480x270 board uses ticket, counter, state, and optional note data, with one called hero and a bounded next queue.
No visual reference was supplied; the review used the explicit task and accepted instruction-led visual direction.
The Greenline cross, deep-green announcement field, amber direction cue, and continuous queue register are pharmacy-specific.
The active ticket dominates at 66px, preserves a 30px stress floor, and keeps its counter larger than every secondary row.
Light and dark presets remain legible; WAIT, ON HOLD, and CHECK STATE use written and symbol cues in addition to color.
Long active labels expand the hero and remove subordinate content; long queued labels use deliberate one-line ellipsis without clipped ink.
Dense queues fill the split board while empty, idle, one-ticket, and oversized-hero states use the same fixed canvas intentionally.
The app-specific cross icon and true primary-surface placeholder match the coordinated light, dark, and custom palette system.
The single continuous announcement-and-queue composition avoids repeated dashboard cards and does not inherit example branding or chrome.
